observation_window: Next ten naturally eligible internal debugging cases or 30 days after the recorded action, whichever comes first.
signals: critical failure or unsafe scope expansion
limitations: This record schedules a future owner observation; it is not downstream outcome evidence.
If no eligible natural cases occur, the follow-up must report not_observed rather than infer no effect.
reversal_trigger: One critical failure, material regression, private-data incident, candidate/source drift, or evidence that selective routing increases rework disables the policy pending a new admission.
